_comment: SIH26174 • VYOM: AI Human Activity Recognition for On-board BAS Experiments
protocol_name: ISRO Red & Yellow Box BAS Experiment
description: Official ISRO Biological & Physical Sciences On-Board Activity Recognition sample experiment.

steps.name: START
steps.description: Experiment initialized. Ready to calibrate camera and workspace.
steps.next_suggestion: Place both RED and YELLOW sample boxes into workspace view.

steps.name: DETECT_MAIN_BOX
steps.description: Baseline verification: Both RED and YELLOW boxes detected simultaneously.
steps.next_suggestion: Grasp and remove the RED box from workspace.

steps.name: REMOVE_RED_BOX
steps.description: Operator extracts RED box with hand interaction. YELLOW remains in workspace.
steps.next_suggestion: Grasp and remove the YELLOW box from workspace.

steps.name: REMOVE_YELLOW_BOX
steps.description: Operator extracts YELLOW box with hand interaction. Both boxes absent.
steps.next_suggestion: Place the RED box back onto the workspace.

steps.name: PLACE_RED_BOX
steps.description: Operator returns RED box to workspace with hand interaction.
steps.next_suggestion: Place the YELLOW box back alongside the RED box.

steps.name: PLACE_YELLOW_BOX
steps.description: Operator returns YELLOW box alongside RED with hand interaction.
steps.next_suggestion: Withdraw hands from workspace to verify stationary placement.

steps.name: VERIFY_BOTH_PLACED
steps.description: Post-placement verification: Both boxes stable in workspace.
steps.next_suggestion: Withdraw hands. Verify both boxes stationary in workspace.

steps.name: COMPLETED
steps.description: All protocol milestones verified successfully. Experiment complete.
steps.next_suggestion: Mission complete. All milestones achieved. Telemetry logged.
